name: persona.handoff
rests_on: agents_workspace.inbox task create/handoff (+ optional wake turn); exit 0 = transferred

to.description: Target persona id. The sender is AGENTS_PERSONA and cannot be set.

task_id.description: Existing tsk_<id> to move (handoff). Omit to create a new task owned by --to.

note.description: Free-form note / context for the receiver

wake.description: Also start a delegate turn as the target persona so it picks the task up now
